title: maavaDao AI tool
description: One AI product, site or suite (open source or not). The file lives at tools/<first character>/<slug>.toml.

name.description: The product's name as its makers write it.

description.description: One or two plain sentences: what it does and who it helps. Your own words or the tool's own site, never text copied from another directory.

pricing.description: free: no charge. freemium: free plan plus paid plans. paid: no free plan (a trial doesn't count). contact: price on request.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for starting_price. USD if not set.

pricing_url.description: The tool's own pricing page, where the prices above were read.

pricing_checked.description: When someone last checked the prices against the pricing page.

open_source.description: True if the source code is open.

education_discount.description: Has a free or discounted plan for schools, teachers or students.
